_purpose: Sample ITN payload PayFast POSTs to F3 (app/api/tickets/itn) as application/x-www-form-urlencoded on payment completion. F3 parses this, EXCLUDES 'signature' from the recomputed base string, validates in this order (all fail-closed): (1) signature match, (2) source IP in PayFast host set, (3) amount_gross matches the reserved ticket.amount within 0.01, (4) server-confirm POST-back to /eng/query/validate returns body 'VALID'. Only if ALL pass AND payment_status === 'COMPLETE' does the ticket flip to 'paid'. The signature value here matches itn_with_passphrase in signature-vectors.json.
